pullRequest.title: Import the class roster from the office CSV
pullRequest.body: The school office exports the roster as CSV (`id,name,form,allergies`, allergy codes separated by `;`). This adds `npm run import -- <file.csv>`, which rewrites data/roster.json from that export so we stop copying it by hand. Allergy codes are expanded from data/allergens.json.
pullRequest.author: sam

comments.author: ruth
comments.body: Question: the office export sometimes lists a student twice (once per club they joined). What does the import do with a duplicate row? I'm not asking for a change, I just need to know what to tell the office.

comments.author: ruth
comments.body: The office export pads names and forms with spaces, e.g. `S014, Maya Chen ,5B ,N`. Can the import trim them? Otherwise the slip list shows ' Maya Chen ' and the form sort goes wrong.
